This war has been going on for nearly five years, and somehow the one thing that never seems to run out is money

Zelensky keeps asking for more, Europe keeps sending it, and ordinary Europeans, especially Ukrainians, are the ones paying the price with their lives.

Europe doesn't want this war to end, and Zelensky doesn't seem much interested in ending it either. They just keep pretending they're working toward peace while the money keeps flowing

Hundreds of billions have been poured into this war, and we're supposed to believe there aren't massive financial and political incentives to keep the whole thing going? Come on

And don't forget the fact that Ukraine didn't even had election since 2019

The political elites get to make speeches, demand more money, and pretend they're saving the world while ordinary families bury their children

It's absolutely insane how this has become an endless cycle of asking for money, sending money, and sending people to die, with no end in sight

posts.author: elonmusk
posts.text:
Elon Musk just shared how Tesla came within hours of dying on Christmas Eve in 2008, and it's incredible to think how much of the future was hanging on those final hours

“It's difficult to imagine here in 2026 that Tesla actually, you know, has come close to death multiple times, actually

2008 was the worst, and that's where we closed the financing round at 6 p.m. on Christmas Eve, 2008. It's the last hour of the last day that it was possible

We were to bounce payroll a few days after Christmas if the round hadn't closed. So that was pretty stressful”

The millions of Tesla vehicles on the road today, the factories around the world, the Supercharger network, the breakthroughs in energy storage, autonomous driving, and now humanoid robotics. None of that existed at the scale we see today

Everything Tesla has accomplished, and everything Elon is still building toward, traces back to a company that was just days away from not being able to pay its own employees
